sourceSentences: [0] You're both poking each other down with your Q's. Whoever wins that wins the Q Q match up game just wins the lane, right?
[0] Um and they both are pretty bad in the long trade. They're good in the short trade.

[2] the alt does like half someone's health if you land all four bullets.
[2] just getting someone to the 50% 40% threshold and popping alt. That is your that is kind of your win condition for allins.
[2] all his damage is inbuilt into three things. His Q bounce, his fourth shot, and his R.
[2] people do just run into the alt like a pack of chickens. They just run in like clucking getting hit by the alt
[3] Be careful of the Double Up(Q) that bounces off minions. The slow on Make it Rain(E) also poses a threat to Jhin as he does not have any movement related skills!
